feeds.title: Highly Sensitive Refuge
feeds.description: A community for highly sensitive people (HSPs). Get insight and inspiration about high sensitivity and turn your sensitivity into your most powerful trait. Our Mission is to change the way the world sees and talks about, highly sensitive people

feeds.title: Judith Orloff MD » Empaths Highly Sensitive People
feeds.description: Read news, stories, and articles on Highly Sensitive People in the following segment of Empaths. Dr. Orloff is accomplishing psychiatry. She is proving that the links between physical, emotional, and spiritual health can't be ignored.

feeds.title: The Highly Sensitive Person Blog
feeds.description: Welcome. I'm Elaine Aron. I began researching high sensitivity in 1991 and continue to research it now, also calling it Sensory-Processing Sensitivity. My husband, Dr. Arthur Aron, are two leading scientists studying the psychology of love and close relationships. We are also pioneers in studying sensitivity and love using functional magnetic resonance imaging.

feeds.title: Happy Sensitive Kids
feeds.description: Happy Sensitive Kids Blog is a blog Inspiring and supporting parents to raise confident highly sensitive children who flourish, not in spite of, but because of their sensitive traits.

feeds.title: HiSensitives Blog
feeds.description: We are Anne-Kathrin and Riny and we are the founders of the brand HiSensitives. HiSensitives is a personal growth platform for highly sensitive people and empaths. With this platform, we created a place that hands you effective personal growth tools and connects you with the right people to realize personal growth within you.

feeds.title: HSP Tools
feeds.description: Welcome to HSP Tools. My name is Selipha and I'm the face behind the words, graphics, and curations on this blog. I share the latest news, tips, tools, and resources to help Highly Sensitive People (HSPs) live their best HSP lives.

feeds.title: Sustainably Sensitive Blog
feeds.description: Get updates about the latest news about HSP at Sustainably Sensitive Blog. Hi, I'm Emily Agnew. I'm a Focusing and Inner Bonding teacher, mentor, professional musician, writer, and a highly sensitive person.

feeds.title: Sara Ouimette Blog
feeds.description: HI! I am Sara, Ouimette's on my blog read articles about highly sensitive people, psycho-spiritual healing, psychedelics, bad trips, cannabis use, trauma and complex trauma, women's issues, men's issues, and millennials. I am a depth psychotherapist and spiritual counselor based in Oakland, California. I enjoy helping people make the internal shifts necessary to feel more joy in their lives.

feeds.title: Sensitive and Strong Blog
feeds.description: Take a look at the most recent stories about Highly Sensitive People at Sensitive and Strong Blog. Hi! I'm Cheri Gregory The place for the HSP Christian woman to find a connection. I believe that every Highly Sensitive Christian woman can grow in confidence, candor, and contentment.

feeds.title: The Highly Sensitive Person Blog
feeds.description: I'm Cliff Harwin. Through my extensive experience as a husband, father, business owner, and highly sensitive person, I offer a unique perspective of life. I do my best to focus on the positive aspects of high sensitivity and provide advice for dealing with the challenges. I hope you can benefit from the lessons I have learned!

feeds.title: Clare Myatt Blog
feeds.description: On Clare Myatt's Blog read articles on issues such as addiction, vulnerability, and somatic coaching. gratitude, trust. I am a somatic coach and psychotherapist. I'm committed to a somatic approach no matter what you do or want to do, the body determines your capacity, competence, potential, motivation, and implementation.

feeds.title: Heal Your Nervous System Blog
feeds.description: Take a glance at the most recent articles from The Highly Sensitive Nervous System Blog. HYNS provides personalized care for sensitive people. Dr. Linnea has dedicated 20+ years to serving patients, With her team's help, she brings ancient Buddhist principles into modern-day neuroscience to support the nervous system of sensitive people who are struggling with overwhelm, burnout and anxiety.

feeds.title: Highly Sensitive
feeds.description: Highly Sensitive is part of the Creative Mind series of sites by Douglas Eby. This site is about a variety of personal and social aspects of the personality trait of high sensitivity, technically called sensory processing sensitivity.Also, there are articles and other material about shyness and introversion, which for many of us seem to overlap with being highly sensitive.

feeds.title: The Happy Sensitive
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Caroline. I enjoy helping empathic sensitive people like you to create more compassionate joy in their lives. As HSPs we tend to have lots of empathy for everyone! else, but we often leave ourselves out of the compassion equation. Why is that? Anyway, it's time for that to change! Empathic Sensitivity is the intelligent key to compassionate joy

feeds.title: Brenda Knowles of Space2live Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I am Brenda Knowles. I've been writing for space2live for over seven years. I've written over 400 posts on introversion, relationships, anxiety, resiliency, and parenting. Read personal stories about living and loving as a sensitive introvert. My blog also features articles on relationship help and understanding.

feeds.title: Megghan Thompson Coaching Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Meghan Thompson! I help parents who are worried about managing their child's explosive and out-of-control emotions to develop an individualized system to manage their kid's explosive feelings when they don't fit the examples in typical parenting books.

feeds.title: Intuitive Warrior Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I am Brooke. I'm a therapist, writer, and speaker who believes that unconditional acceptance and the right support have the power to transform us. I created Intuitive Warrior, to provide coaching, community, and courses to HSPs around the world so that they can find the profound gifts in what they thought were the worst parts of themselves and transform their overwhelm into lives of dynamic calm, even-keeled energy, and rich relationships.

feeds.title: Highly Sensitive Humans Blog
feeds.description: Check out the latest articles on Highly Sensitive People. This blog shares the best resources, information, and scientific research for Highly Sensitive People all around the world. I'm Jules De Vito, the founder of Highly Sensitive Humans. My mission is to empower Highly Sensitive People by providing resources to manage emotional overwhelm and guide HSP to embody their authentic gifts and purpose in life.

feeds.title: Jerrica Danhoff Psychotherapy Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I am Jerrica Danhoff on my blog you can read about tips and support for highly sensitive people. I'm here to tell you that you are not alone, and you are not broken. In our work together, we'll tame your strong inner critic and embrace your natural strengths to help you be authentically you in the world. Together, we'll move toward embracing your authentic self rather than fighting against it.

feeds.title: Jenny Walters Blog
feeds.description: I'm Jenny. I'm a depth therapist and coach for sensitive people, both HSPs and folks who feel emotionally sensitive, and I believe your sensitivity is a strength to be celebrated and used; not a weakness to be feared. I help sensitive people step into their power, find their voice, and create revolutionary change.

feeds.title: Shira Klazmer Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I am Shira Klezmer, I offer therapy services for Highly Sensitive People. I work with adults to create a collaborative dynamic to assist in reaching goals. I work with individual clients ages 18+. Those who have experienced high sensitivity throughout their lives may be very sensitive to textures, smells, lighting, noise, and emotions.
